function.arguments: {"index": 5, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The `channel` variable is confounded by `customer_segment` because the email campaign was deliberately targeted at loyal customers, who are more likely to convert. A raw comparison of conversion rates between email and paid_search would be biased. To obtain an unbiased estimate of the effect of the email campaign on conversion, we must adjust for `customer_segment`. We computed the difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search) within each segment and then took a weighted average of these differences, weighted by the total number of customers in each segment across the entire sample. This is the standard method to adjust for confounding in observational studies. The resulting adjusted difference is -0.1279, indicating that the email campaign had a lower conversion rate than paid_search, after accounting for segment."}
function.name: resolve_finding
